title: Sex Differences in E-Cigarette Perception
official: Sex Differences in E-Cigarette Perception: Study 2
summary: This study examines differences between males and females in the appeal and addiction potential of menthol flavored e-cigarettes with and without nicotine.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Able to read/write in English
* Current cigarette smoking
* Prior e-cigarette exposure
* Biochemically verified cigarette use
* Not trying to quit tobacco use

Exclusion Criteria:

* Significant medical concerns that would increase study risk
* Use of psychoactive drugs unless prescribed and stable
* Allergy to menthol or other e-liquid ingredients
* Dislike of menthol
* Pregnant, trying to get pregnant, breastfeeding
